prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: square 1024 x 1024 image for a repeatable local AI inpainting benchmark. Create a single high-quality photographic image, not a grid. Scene: a natural garden meadow of small purple and white flowers, a winding pale gravel path receding toward a timber fence and distant trees, overcast late-afternoon soft daylight, coherent photographic depth and perspective, real petal and leaf detail, slight depth of field. Subject: one small matte terracotta orange ceramic sphere resting directly among the flowers at approximately 28 percent across and 72 percent down, with its full silhouette and short contact shadow visible. Sphere diameter approximately 13 percent of image width. Leave clear surrounding flowers on every side of the sphere for an edit mask and context. Wide garden view, sphere off-centre in lower-left quadrant, no other orange objects. Natural restrained colors and consistent diffuse lighting. No words, labels, watermark, border or UI. This must look like a plausible camera photograph with abundant continuous surrounding ground texture.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: square 1024 x 1024 image for a repeatable local AI object removal benchmark. Create one realistic interior photograph, not a grid. Scene: a warmly lit quiet kitchen, white lightly veined marble countertop in foreground, softly focused pale cabinets and window in background, strong but soft-edged daylight entering from upper left. Subject: one simple mustard-yellow ceramic coffee mug with a curved handle, resting on the marble at approximately 57 percent across and 67 percent down. Full mug, handle and its natural soft cast shadow extending right are clearly visible, mug height approximately 22 percent of image height. Marble surface remains unobstructed on every side, veins continue naturally beneath it. A folded blue linen towel far left and a small glass jar far back provide context and must not overlap mug. Photograph at countertop level with a slight downward angle, realistic reflected light and fine surface texture, coherent geometry. No text, lettering, logos, watermark, border or UI.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: square 1024 x 1024 image for a repeatable local AI fabric-detail replacement benchmark. One realistic editorial portrait photograph, not a grid. Scene: an adult woman in her thirties with short curly dark brown hair, smiling naturally while standing at a softly blurred outdoor cafe with leafy plants. Framing from head to waist, centered, both shoulders fully visible, calm soft daylight with light from camera left. She wears a richly textured medium-blue denim overshirt with clear seams, gentle folds and plausible buttons. One small round enamel brooch, muted coral red with a simple white geometric dot, pinned to the left side of the displayed shirt at approximately 67 percent across and 66 percent down. Brooch diameter approximately 7 percent of image width, front-facing with a tiny contact shadow. Plenty of uninterrupted denim around brooch, no straps, hair or fingers covering it. Natural adult proportions, convincing face, realistic hair, skin, denim weave and color. No typography, lettering, brand marks, watermark, frame or UI.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: square 1024 x 1024 image for a repeatable local AI planar-art replacement benchmark. Scene: charming brick storefront with reddish weathered brickwork, mortar lines, dark green timber doorway to the right, pavement below, a small potted fern near doorway. On the left-middle brick wall at approximately 34 percent across and 48 percent down hangs a simple rectangular dark metal poster frame, approximately 25 percent of image width and 37 percent of image height. Inside it is a clean cream paper poster showing a simple muted orange botanical abstract leaf drawing without any text. The entire poster and frame are visible. Camera almost frontal with a slight real perspective angle, horizontal and vertical brick lines remain straight and coherent. Soft late-morning daylight, subtle reflections on frame glass, realistic weathering, gentle contact shadow behind frame. Enough visible brickwork around all frame edges for context. No words, numbers, signs, logos, watermark, border or UI.
